items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Byfield liked me very much and he liked my MCing of the show and they needed an MC and a house band. Over at the Sherman Hotel in the Panther Room.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. And then we moved from that on to ......

See, I talked about Art Tatum. Oh, another thing in Chicago there, that I might talk about. It was after 'The Three Deuces', was the man, Mr. Byfield liked me very much and he liked my MCing of the show and they needed an MC and a house band. Over at the Sherman Hotel in the Panther Room.
So I went over there and started. As a matter of fact when I opened there were three bands. I was in the Panther Room. And Gene Krupa was in one of the rooms and Jimmy Dorsey was in another room.
